verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same broken layout. The small cross icon is blown up into a huge, blurry blue cross in the centre that becomes the main focal point. The dates are tiny and jammed against the top edge, 'WORSHIP & BIBLE STUDY' floats on its own, and the invite copy is tiny and pushed to the bottom left, so the reading order falls apart. B's date line is set a touch larger and more open, but that is the only visible difference, so they are effectively the same.
